notes.title: V0.1.14 - Playtest Version
notes.notes:
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fog (for game ending)
[*] Skip Settle Phase voting
[*] Item drop polishing: Animated + VFX
[*] Resource left over on destroying trees/boulders
[/list]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemy Trigger on distance to player/turtle
[*] Enemy slows turtle
[*] Enemy killable via dash
[/list]

[h2]Obstacles[/h2]
[list]
[*] Spawn System on turtle path
[*] Turtle stopping infront of obstacles
[/list]

[list]
[*] First Time Opened the Game
[*] Turtle walked in meters
[*] Chop down trees
[*] Boulders destroyed

[/list]

[*] Local Save
[/list]

[*] fixed islands not removing on game progress
[*] On Breaking interacteable resource flies from host instead of based on client
[*] fix visually multiple host
[/list]
